title: Rough render excessive eating
description: Connectable Grill with attached skewers and skewer sticks; added extra light effect layers that can be triggered with this mod's seasoning bottle by right-clicking a skewer on the grill. Added Hot Pot Block,Simple food music system
body:
Still a simple, GUI-free AI mod. Added the following features:
Simple food music system: BGM now plays when you eat food.
Author Block and Author Staff for various adjustments.
Connectable grill with attached skewers, skewer sticks, and crafting table. Added extra light effect layers that can be activated using this mod's seasoning bottle by right-clicking a skewer on the grill. Also added Hot Pot Block: it only stores two items internally, but you can jump in and swim inside it.
Added dumplings – hastily made mixed vegetable and meat dumplings.
The staff from this mod is only used to adjust the connection state of the grill; shears can disconnect it.
Added "oil-water flying" feature.
